messages:
ana: quick sync — proposing 'Hybrid Compute' SMB tier (metered compute band + token cap) to give small customers predictable latency without full reserved capacity. thinking: base monthly $99 includes 50k tokens + 10 compute-units/hour pooled. add-on: priority-burst 2x for $49/mo. draft SKU: HYB-SMB-M1

devin: customers asking for something like this — SMBs hate surprises. any idea how billing shows up? they want per-route caps.

sara: billing note: need new metered dimension 'compute_units' in billing pipeline, expected invoice delta ~ +10% infra tagging effort. also need to confirm proration rules.

matt: runtime impact: we can enforce compute units via routing + per-tenant token budget. will need rate-limiter change + quota enforcement. estimate 2 sprint tickets.

lee: pilot candidates: AcmeApp, BeaconHealth, and Parkly. prefer soft launch with 3 customers for 6 weeks.

jules: legal: watch for 'predictable latency' wording. can't promise SLOs without SLA tier. propose 'best-effort low-latency' in marketing + optional SLA add-on.

ana: (typo) — ignore^^

ana_fixed: (correcting) ana: launch criteria draft: 1) billing dimension implemented; 2) routing + quota enforcement in staging; 3) telemetry: per-tenant p95 latency < 300ms for non-burst; 4) verified accounting for compute_units in cost reports; 5) 3 pilot customers onboarded.

devin: sales asks: need playbook: upsell path to Dedicated and ability to convert remaining compute to reserved credits on renewal.

matt: technical design note: proposal to implement soft token ring + bucket for compute_units. sample config:
```
compute_band:
  base_units: 10
  burst_multiplier: 2
```
we'll gate burst by circuit-breaker.

sara: finance asks for expected ARR lift scenario: conservative $30k/yr, target $180k/yr if 10% conversion in 6 months. need ACV model.

ana_fixed2: ana: product question: pricing elastic vs fixed? i'm leaning fixed monthly + metered usage overage.

lee: ops: need rollout docs for onboard + migration path if they later move to Dedicated.

jules: also need opt-out legal language for data residency if we do burst routing across regions.

billing-bot: INFO: created billing ticket #BIL-4592 for dimension 'compute_units' assigned to sara.

devin: :thumbsup: from sales on pilot list. can we get a timeline?

matt: timeline: billing + routing changes in 2 sprints, pilot infra ready week after, so internal launch in ~6 weeks.

ana_final: ana: ok i'll update roadmap and prep a short PRD with the launch criteria and pilot plan. tagging follow-ups: @sara @matt @lee @jules @devin :thumbsup:
